title: My Profile
subtitle: Manage how you sign in and keep your account secure.

idle.title: Still there?
idle.message: For your security, you'll be signed out in {seconds} seconds due to inactivity.

password.title: Password
password.setDescription: A password is set on this account.
password.unsetDescription: This account signs in with Google SSO or a passkey — no password is set.
password.mismatch: New password and confirmation do not match.
password.tooShort: New password must be at least 12 characters.

totp.title: Authenticator app
totp.enabledDescription: You use a time-based code from an authenticator app as a second factor.
totp.disabledDescription: Add a one-time code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy…).
totp.scanInstruction: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the six-digit code to confirm.
totp.manualSummary: Can't scan? Paste this secret manually
totp.removePasswordPrompt: Enter your current password to confirm.

passkeys.title: Passkeys & security keys
passkeys.description: Sign in without a password using Touch ID, Windows Hello, a synced passkey, or a hardware security key (YubiKey).
passkeys.add: Add a passkey or security key
passkeys.empty: No passkeys or security keys registered yet.
passkeys.removeConfirm: Remove this passkey? You won't be able to use it to sign in anymore.
passkeys.registerFailed: Could not register the authenticator. Please try again.

interrupted.message: Your session expired before your last action was saved, so it was NOT applied. Nothing was changed.
